package.alt_text: An educational carousel detailing the announcement of the Acme Enterprise assistant on 2026-09-20. It covers the confirmed features like centralized administrative controls and Acme Data Workspace integration, but highlights major data gaps for procurement managers, including the lack of pricing, security certifications, geographic availability, and deployment details.
package.caption:
When evaluating new enterprise AI tools, what is left unsaid can be just as critical as what is announced.

Acme's 2026-09-20 announcement of an Enterprise assistant for October 2026 features administrative controls and workspace integration. However, critical details regarding pricing, security certifications, geographic availability, and deployment requirements are completely missing, preventing full procurement approvals.

Review your October 2026 planning checklist.

#acmeupdate #aitools #enterpriseai #procurement
